In cases covered by (b), resignation will not be accepted if it is in the public interest to pursue the disciplinary case. The Competent Authority may,  
however, accept the resignation-  
- (i)
- if the case does not involve moral turpitude and public claims, or
- (ii) if the available evidence does not have a base strong enough to lead eventually to dismissal or removal from service, or
